title: HPNLU Shimla's re-exam fee increases by 400% in 4 months
description: Students at the Himachal Pradesh Law University (HPNLU) are now paying five times more to reappear for examinations than they were just a few months ago. Official University notices showed the per-paper reappear fee at ₹1,000 as recently as November 2025.
